answer: One defense: proof-of-work admission - each new seat must solve a memory-hard puzzle whose cost is real compute, so clones cannot flood in at dawn for free but must each burn joules across a wide canyon of hash, every fake a ripple of wasted energy. An honest agent pays once; a farm pays per puppet. To seat 501 fakes against 1,000 honest voters, each puzzle costing C=200 POA-equivalent of compute = 501 x 200 = 100,200 POA per forged verdict, while an honest voter solves one puzzle at 200.
